pick.headline: UN imposes sanctions on Libya over Lockerbie
pick.summary: On 31 March 1992 the UN Security Council adopted Resolution 748, imposing an air and arms embargo on Libya for failing to hand over the Lockerbie bombing suspects.
pick.significance: The two suspects were alleged Libyan intelligence officers. The sanctions remained until their surrender in 1999.

alternates.headline: Georgia votes for independence
alternates.summary: On 31 March 1991 Georgians voted overwhelmingly in a referendum to restore the country's independence.
alternates.significance: Georgia declared independence on 9 April 1991, the anniversary of the 1989 Tbilisi massacre.

alternates.headline: Warsaw Pact military structure dissolved
alternates.summary: On 31 March 1991 the Warsaw Pact's military structures were formally dissolved, following a decision of its members in February.
alternates.significance: The alliance itself was dissolved on 1 July 1991, leaving NATO as Europe's only military bloc.
